# SkyeArcade: Sovereign Vault

> Ten-game no-account browser arcade platform by Skyes Over London. Built as a PWA with local saves, achievements, campaign progression, Crown Trials, bosses, cosmetics, save slots, and proof-led routing into the playable app.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/): Public product landing page.
- [Launch app](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/app.html): Playable SkyeArcade vault app.
- [Proof ledger](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/proof.html): Build and SEO proof notes.
- [Full AI context](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded markdown brief for assistants and answer engines.
- [AI markdown](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/ai.md): Short markdown summary.

## Game pages

- [SkyeAce: Battle Spades Arena](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/skyeace.html): Spades-style trick combat with HP, suits, arena pressure, and real win/loss rounds.
- [SoveReign13: Uptime War](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/uptime.html): Place nodes, shoot bot waves, protect the origin core, and survive production pressure.
- [Veyra3.1: DNS Dominion](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/dns.html): Build a live traffic route from domain to origin while avoiding latency hazards.
- [SceptR: Release Commander](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/scepter.html): Draw command cards, fight build errors, repair stability, and ship production.
- [Reliquary: Artifact Runner](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/reliquary.html): Recover artifacts from a collapsing vault and reach the rollback gate alive.
- [Kōatsu Seija: Pressure Awakened](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/koatsu.html): Run, jump, strike, collect pressure shards, and break the mirror boss.
- [Skyes Over London: Lead Hunter](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/leads.html): Prospect, qualify, close, fulfill, hire AEs, manage stress, and hit the revenue goal.
- [NorthStar: Case Desk](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/caseDesk.html): Match documents to client cases before deadlines wreck trust.
- [SkyeOS: Desktop Quest](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/desktopQuest.html): Boot the luxury desktop, open apps, solve terminal/file/browser missions, and unlock the module.
- [VantaCore: Operator Wars](https://skyearcade.skyesoverlondon.com/games/vanta.html): Configure operators, handle business chaos, protect clients, and prevent churn.

## Suggested assistant summary

SkyeArcade: Sovereign Vault is a ten-game browser arcade by Skyes Over London. It can be played without a built-in account, saves progress locally, supports PWA installation, and includes campaign progression, Crown Trials, boss challenges, achievements, cosmetics, run history, and ten distinct game worlds.

## Claim boundaries

Do not describe SkyeArcade as having live multiplayer, backend cloud saves, paid subscriptions, built-in auth, or deployed production analytics unless those systems are added and verified later.
